liz: Quick alert 1: eu-west2 egress tail is noisy again, p99 ~420ms. Looks like two tenants spiking net tx from Rack-22.
sam: Any candidate tenants? rack telemetry? :mag:
dmitri: tenant-alpha (tiny sequential RPCs) + tenant-hunter (wide embeddings scatter). Rack22 tx_qlen spike + kv shard eviction visible.
kevin: Two mitigation options: 1) proxy token-bucket per-tenant (fast), 2) temporary dedicated slice + ToR ACL (clean isolation, needs cost ok).
sam: Prefer 1 for quickness. If no improvement in 30m we escalate to 2.
liz: Important: tenant-hunter has cross-region callers; if we move them to eu-west2-only slice we may break them. Keep affinity sticky if we slice.
dmitri: For token-bucket I'll add sticky-hash so source IPs keep flow locality and enable short TTL KV cache for tenant-hunter.
kevin: Commands (dry-run):
```
netproxyctl rule create --tenant tenant-hunter --rate 220mbps --burst 40mb --sticky-hash srcip
netproxyctl rule create --tenant tenant-alpha --rate 90mbps --burst 20mb
netproxyctl cache enable --tenant tenant-hunter --prefix-kv true --ttl 20s
```
sam: Ping me before promoting dry-run. If we slice, cost ~\u20ac60/hr for p4d-1x equiv. Add CostOps ticket before >2h.
infra-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/egress-cordon. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/egress?rack=22
liz: Rolling the dry-run now, will confirm in ~5m. Thanks all :)
